from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    # Extend a repeated diagonal marker in the direction established by the seed.
    pts={v:[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==v and x!=1] for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row)}
    color=3
    for v, cells in pts.items():
        for (r,c) in cells:
            if (r+1,c+1) in cells:
                color=v
                rr,cc=r+2,c+2
                while rr<h and cc<w:
                    out[rr][cc]=color
                    rr+=1;cc+=1
                return out
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-2ad7c8fc.py'; p.write_text(code)
